description: A mounted soldier in khaki with a wide-brimmed slouch hat, a plume on the hat, and a rifle with a fixed bayonet, riding a dark bay horse at a gallop over dusty, smoky, churned ground. Other mounted riders in similar hats show through the haze behind him, and a distant town skyline with a spire sits on the right horizon. The oil-painting style is warm browns and ochres, the painting fills the frame edge to edge, and there is no visible text.
reason: Shows a mounted soldier charging with a bayonet rifle across a battlefield, but the card is Nancy Astor taking her seat in the House of Commons. Nothing in the picture shows Parliament or a woman MP; repaint as a woman entering a chamber of the Commons in 1919.
